description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2024: Rate of Consolidation in Fine-Grained Willamette Silt is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Diego Moreno, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This project is about the rate of consolidation in fine-grained Willamette Silt and how this affects permeability of the silt, along with consolidation time. This data can be reused if others wish to also test silt within the centrifuge and need to see if they will have enough time to spin. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-zzv9-vb11. Keywords: NSF NHERI UC Davis CGM, Silt,  Centrifuge,  Consolidation,  Excess Pore Pressure,  Post-Shaking. Published 2024-08-23. Facility named: Center for Geotechnical Modeling - University of California, Davis. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
